source_name: Portal NIO — ERAR asset record (nacionalni interoperabilnostni okvir)
why_relevant: NIO is Slovenia's interoperability/asset catalogue for public-sector IT solutions. Beyond the ERAR record it indexes the software assets, data models and interoperability specs of Slovenian government systems — a secondary route to discovering which integrators build state financial IT.

source_name: CPV — Enotni besednjak javnih naročil (Common Procurement Vocabulary) on TED, Slovenian
why_relevant: Authoritative CPV code list with Slovenian labels. Gives the exact native wording for each target code (66100000 storitve bančništva in investicijskega bančništva, 66110000 bančne storitve, 66172000 obdelava plačilnih transakcij, 30144200 stroji za izdajanje bankovcev / bankomati), which is what makes the national-portal cross-matching and sl-language searching precise.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Katalog informacij javnega značaja
why_relevant: Central bank's own FOI catalogue: names the categories of information it holds and its FOI contact/route. Directly relevant because Banka Slovenije is both a procurement authority for payment infrastructure and a frequent FOI respondent (it appears as an obliged party in IPRS decisions).

source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS-GIZ) – Članice (member list)
why_relevant: Authoritative membership list of the Bank Association of Slovenia — member banks, savings banks and leasing companies. Directly enumerates the Slovenian bank buyer universe for tenders and RFPs.

source_name: ZBS – Organiziranost / committees and working bodies
why_relevant: Committee and working-group structure names the bank staff who own payments, cards, IT security and compliance agendas — the people who define requirements before a tender is published.

source_name: AJPES — Katalog informacij javnega značaja
why_relevant: AJPES's own catalogue of the public-information databases it holds. A meta-index: it enumerates every AJPES register/evidence, which is the reliable way to discover AJPES data assets beyond the well-known ePRS/JOLP/RTR trio.

source_name: KPK archive site (arhiv.kpk-rs.si)
why_relevant: Legacy KPK content (older findings, FAQs, guidance) that was not migrated to the current CMS. Necessary for historical depth on procurement cases predating the site redesign.

entity_name: Court of Audit of the Republic of Slovenia
source_name: Računsko sodišče RS – Seznam revidirancev (auditee index, incl. Banka Slovenije)
why_relevant: Entity-indexed view of every audit ever performed on a given body. The Banka Slovenije auditee page aggregates all audits of the central bank (e.g. supervisory-function audits); equivalent pages exist for SID banka, ministries and agencies. This is the fastest actor-first route into audit material relevant to banking and payments.

source_name: Halcom – corporate history / 30-years retrospective page
why_relevant: Retrospective pages name historical bank customers and national payment-reform programmes (1997-2001 payment traffic reform, 2007 SEPA/euro migration), yielding an actor map of Slovenian banks and clearing bodies to scout further.

source_name: Javnirazpisi.com — tender aggregator and CPV reference
why_relevant: Claims to sweep 4000+ sources of javna naročila and javni razpisi beyond the national portal (bulletins, newspapers, individual authority websites), so its coverage map points to publication channels our cell would otherwise miss. Also hosts a usable Slovenian CPV-code reference for building the banking/payments code list.

source_name: GZS – Zbornica / sectoral association directory (26 sectoral associations)
why_relevant: Umbrella chamber index: from here the finance-adjacent and ICT sectoral associations (and their member directories) can be enumerated, giving a broad supplier-side actor map beyond ZIT.

source_name: GZS – Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije (ZIT), Članstvo
why_relevant: The chamber's ICT association — the supply side. Its membership/board pages enumerate the Slovenian IT vendors and integrators most likely to bid on bank and public-sector payment tenders.

source_name: OCP Data Registry — Slovenia (Ministry of Public Administration OCDS publication)
why_relevant: Registry entry describing Slovenia's OCDS-formatted procurement publication (via the They Buy For You platform). Tells you whether a standardised, machine-readable contracting feed exists, where it lives, and how current it is — the cheapest path to structured award/contract data.

source_name: Open Contracting Partnership Data Registry - TED/OpenTender publication entry
why_relevant: Registry entry documenting the TED/OpenTender publication, its format, coverage and quality caveats. A meta-source for judging whether an aggregator's SI coverage is complete, and a route to other OCDS publishers that may cover SI.

source_name: OP-TED eForms Notice Viewer (GitHub)
why_relevant: Reference implementation that renders any eForms notice XML to HTML in a chosen language. Practical way to produce human-readable Slovenian and English renderings of collected SI notices for analyst review without building a renderer.

source_name: Apify 'EU TED Tenders' scraper actor
why_relevant: Off-the-shelf collector for TED notices filterable by country/CPV/date/value/notice type with JSON output. A ready-made ingestion path for the SI slice of TED without building a parser; also a POINTER to the field schema other resellers normalise to.

source_name: AppsRunTheWorld – Temenos T24 customer list
why_relevant: Third-party aggregated customer database naming banks per core-banking product; useful to enumerate Slovenian institutions on a given vendor stack and then hunt for the matching vendor press release.

entity_name: ASEE / Asseco digital banking case-study library
source_name: ASEE / Asseco digital banking case-study library
why_relevant: Hosts downloadable named case-study PDFs (e.g. Telenor banka) on a predictable wp-content path — a harvestable corpus of award evidence and a pointer to further bank customers in the region.

source_name: Blockchain Alliance Europe (Slovenia-based)
why_relevant: Slovenian-registered blockchain/crypto industry association; membership overlaps heavily with the domestic fintech/crypto-payments vendor pool.

source_name: Careerjet Slovenia – job aggregator (per-company views)
why_relevant: Aggregator that pulls postings from many SI boards and corporate ATS pages into one searchable per-company view — an efficient discovery layer to find WHICH boards a given bank/vendor actually uses, which can then be monitored directly.

source_name: eu-skladi.si - legacy Slovenian EU cohesion funds portal (2014-2020 and archive)
why_relevant: Historical and still-referenced portal of the Government Office for Development and European Cohesion Policy (SVRK). Holds the archive of prior-period calls, beneficiary lists and decisions on co-financing (e.g. SME digital transformation calls funded from ESRR). Useful as the retrospective baseline against which current award activity in financial-sector digitalisation is compared, and as an alias/redirect pointer to evropskasredstva.si.

source_name: Javnanarocila.si — Slovenian tender guidance and listing site
why_relevant: Secondary Slovenian portal covering razpisi, conditions and procedural guidance; useful mainly as a glossary/terminology and procedure-rules pointer (thresholds, procedure types) that improves query construction against the primary portals.

source_name: jnplacila.si — private-sector guidance and documentation on UJP JN Plačila reporting
why_relevant: Non-governmental site hosting UJP JN Plačila user documentation and practical guidance. Useful for understanding data field semantics, B2B interface options and reporting edge cases before building a collector — and it indicates a small ecosystem of SI ERP vendors (Vasco, SAOP iCenter, Minimax) that integrate with public payment reporting; those vendor sites are themselves downstream leads.

source_name: Marand d.o.o. – company site and Technology Park profile
why_relevant: Marand is a 30-year Slovenian ICT integrator whose banking references are not exposed through search; profile pages in the Technology Park Ljubljana directory and business registries are the practical starting point for confirming whether it holds banking-sector work.

source_name: Monitor obvestil o javnih naročilih (informator-javnihrazpisov.si)
why_relevant: A second independent Slovenian notice-monitoring service. Useful as a cross-check on whether our own harvest of the portal is complete, and as a discovery route to authorities publishing outside the main portal.

source_name: Slovenska digitalna koalicija – digitalna.si (working groups and partners)
why_relevant: GZS-coordinated multi-stakeholder digitalisation coalition; its working-group (delovne skupine) and project pages name participating companies and public bodies, including the blockchain/fintech cluster, i.e. a cross-sector actor index.

source_name: Slovensko društvo INFORMATIKA – dogodki (events listing)
why_relevant: Parent association that announces DSI and other professional IT events; the events section is a pointer to each year's conference site and to smaller specialist gatherings where bank IT staff speak.

source_name: Zdruzenje obcin Slovenije (ZOS)
why_relevant: Second municipal association, with a different (largely smaller-municipality) membership than SOS. Publishes news on transparency and administrative tooling for obcine (e.g. covered the ERAR relaunch) and complements the SOS member directory for full actor coverage.
